row.notes: (lib) Robin-hood table insert probe for an 8-byte key: FNV-1a over the 8 bytes times multiplier map+0x10, info byte from low 5 bits (inc +0x40, shift +0x44), mask +0x30, 16-byte slots at +0x18, info bytes at +0x20. Writes {index, status}: 1 = key already present, 2 = empty slot reserved, 3 = slot reserved after shifting later entries up, 0 = failed after 256 retries. Allocates the initial 8-slot table (0xf6 bytes), halves the info increment or rehashes via FUN_1445b0de0 when count +0x28 reaches max load +0x38 (80 percent).
